sources.title: GitHub - gulding/local-agents
sources.snippet: A fully local, self-reflecting, multi-agent AI architecture wrapped in a FastAPI REST endpoint. This engine utilizes Ollama for local inference, ChromaDB for vector-based episodic memory, and a multi-agent consensus loop to evaluate, critique, and improve its own outputs over time.
